capabilities: Display one of 8 virtual cursor styles at pen or mouse coordinates
Configure customizable click animations with style, size, duration, and color
Set device and view rules for mouse vs. pen and Excalidraw vs. elsewhere
Preview cursors and hotspots in a settings gallery
Apply quick presets for common configurations
disambiguation: Not a drawing or inking tool; it only renders a cursor indicator and click effects on top of the app.
extras: The installation section says community plugin approval is pending ("Once Approved"), so it may not yet be listed in the community browser.
motivation: The README explains that Windows and Chromium suppress the hardware mouse cursor on pen contact, making it vanish for graphics-tablet users, and the plugin draws an indicator Windows cannot hide.
problem: Windows and Electron hide the hardware cursor on pen contact, so users of screenless tablets or dual-monitor setups lose sight of the pointer while clicking or drawing.

relations.evidence: Apply rules specifically to Excalidraw views vs. Everywhere else in Obsidian.

summary: Cursor overlay that displays an always-visible virtual pointer (arrow, brush, reticle, laser, etc.) with click animations for stylus, Windows Ink, and mouse input.
